languageDescription: UI language for this interface. Agent content and data stay untranslated.
showStatusDotDesc: Show extra sidebar markers for spawn placeholders, taken-over agents, and terminated agents
showTerminatedDesc: Show terminated agents (red status dot) in the sidebar; off shows only live agents
expandWorkingBlockDesc: Automatically expand the current work block while an agent is working.
timelineMaxWidthDesc: Max width of the conversation column in pixels ({min}px–{max}px). The column fills its pane up to this ceiling and centers with side gutters when wider. Default {def}px.
awaitingReplyDesc: Show the total number of notices awaiting a reply in the sidebar header
confirmTerminateDesc: Show a confirmation dialog when terminating an agent
confirmRestartDesc: Show a confirmation dialog when restarting an agent
confirmForceKillDesc: Show a confirmation dialog when force-killing (kill / SIGKILL) an agent
replySuggestionsDesc: After an agent finishes a turn, suggest replies when they would help you respond. The model chooses how many suggestions to provide. They appear as grey text in the empty input. Use Up/Down to choose, Right to fill the input, then Enter to send. Typing hides the suggestions.

categories.coreNeedsInput: Agent is waiting on your answer
